story.soThat: I can implement provider plugins with correct configuration structure
story.tasks: - Create ProviderConfig interface in src/provider/types.ts - Add required fields: id, provider_type, api_key, model, plugin_id - Create ProviderCapabilities interface with streaming, tools, vision, etc. - Implement providerConfigValidator with ArkType - Use satisfies Type<ProviderConfig> pattern - Update barrel exports in src/provider/index.ts - Add JSDoc documentation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - src/provider/types.ts exports ProviderConfig interface - ProviderConfig includes: id, provider_type, api_key, model, plugin_id - src/provider/types.ts exports ProviderCapabilities interface - ProviderCapabilities includes: streaming, tools, vision, functionCalling, maxTokens - src/provider/validators.ts exports providerConfigValidator (ArkType) - validators use satisfies Type<ProviderConfig> pattern - /provider subpath export includes both types and validators - JSDoc explains plugin_id: string | null (null = legacy fallback)
